events.name: Jurassic Quest – Boise, ID | Expo Idaho
events.description:
The Ultimate Family Adventure Is Here!  

Jurassic Quest is bigger than ever, bringing together dinosaurs, prehistoric sea creatures, and Ice Age giants in one unforgettable experience.  

🦕 Jurassic Quest – Walk among life-sized, moving dinosaurs including the mighty T. rex, towering Apatosaurus, and massive Spinosaurus. Dig for fossils, meet adorable baby dinos, and ride your favorite prehistoric giants.  

🌊 Ancient Oceans – Dive beneath the surface and come face-to-face with incredible creatures that ruled the seas millions of years ago, including our jaw-dropping 53-foot Megalodon.  

❄️ Frozen Frontier – Step into the Ice Age and encounter legendary creatures like the Woolly Mammoth and Saber-Toothed Cat as you explore a world frozen in time.  

Plus enjoy interactive exhibits, hands-on activities, inflatables, rides, photo opportunities, and prehistoric fun for the whole family.  

🎟️ One ticket gets you access to all three incredible experiences. Don't miss North America's largest prehistoric adventure — get your tickets before they go extinct! 🦖✨

events.pleaseNote: Rediscovered Books presents an evening with New York Times bestselling author and Emmy Award-winning MS NOW host, Rachel Maddow in conversation with Idaho Matters' Gemma Goudette. They will be discussing Maddow's newest book Department of Fate: The Promise, the Power, and the Collapse of America's Most Consequential Institution. The discussion will be followed by a Q&A session with the audience. Each ticket holder will receive an unsigned copy of Department of Fate. Additional copies and other books by Maddow will be available to purchase before and after the event. There will not be a signing line. Books must be picked up at the event ($35.00 value). There is a 4 ticket limit.

events.pleaseNote: Experience the warmth and vitality of the Boise State All-Campus Concert Band, a welcoming and talented instrumental ensemble that brings together passionate student musicians and community members from across many academic disciplines. Led by Dr. Joe Tornello, the ensemble's programming philosophy expands musical horizons and offers a supportive environment where players explore an outstanding and diverse repertoire. Bridging the campus and the community, each concert delivers an inspiring, high-energy performance that proves music is a lifelong pursuit belonging to everyone. The All Campus Concert Band will present their fall concert "Of Lightness and Darkness." They are delighted to share the stage with the Summitvue Middle School Symphonic Band, under the direction of Mr. Pat Absalonson. Boise State University Students, Staff and Faculty are eligible for one complimentary ticket - please visit the Morrison Center Ticket Office with valid ID in ADVANCE of performance.

events.pleaseNote: Experience the power and artistry of the Boise State Symphonic Winds, a nationally recognized ensemble of dedicated student musicians performing cornerstone repertoire alongside compelling contemporary works. Led by Dr. Myron Peterson, the ensemble aims to connect people through music, offering programs that challenge audiences to contemplate their relationship with various universal and human themes. Featuring the finest woodwind, brass, and percussion artists on campus, this premier wind band delivers engaging professional performances showcasing technical precision and vivid expression. Symphonic Winds is pleased to share this concert with the Mountain View High School Concert Band under the direction of Mr. Joshua Barro. Boise State University Students, Staff and Faculty are eligible for one complimentary ticket - please visit the Morrison Center Ticket Office with valid ID in ADVANCE of performance.
